# taohq: full context

> taohq is an independent software studio based in India that makes calm, durable apps for everyday life: Fold, Bottles, Sober.Spend and the Bubbles family. It also builds products for clients through its studio, and shares some of its tools with the community as open source.

- Website: https://taohq.org
- Tagline: Software, crafted with care.
- Based in: India. Serves people worldwide.
- Legal entity: TheAlphaOnes (internal name; the public brand is taohq, always lowercase)
- Contact: taohq.org@gmail.com (projects, support, privacy, press and general questions)
- X: https://x.com/TheNormVg
- GitHub: https://github.com/NormVg

## What taohq believes

- Calm: software should lower cognitive load, not compete for attention.
- Thoughtful: every interaction exists for a reason; no decoration that adds nothing.
- Durable: products should keep working for years instead of chasing trends.
- Invisible infrastructure: sign-in, sync, storage and deployment should never be the user's problem.
- No magic: build things that will still make sense in five years.
- Substance over hype: clarity over cleverness, honesty over marketing.

## Products

### Fold
The journaling app for Gen Z ("Journaling, but cool."). A phone journal for photos, voice notes and quick thoughts: tap to write, hold to talk, swipe up to snap. Pages are free-form canvases for photos, songs, GIFs and voice notes. Streaks, monthly "ink", and three daily reminders. No account, no cloud, no ads: the journal lives only on your phone. Free, iOS and Android, coming 2026, opening in waves via a waitlist.
- Page: https://taohq.org/products/fold
- Waitlist: https://fold.taohq.org

### Bottles
Bookmarks and docs, filed properly. A quiet place for your links, notes and files, with no feed and no noise: one space for what you keep, one for what you write. Live on the web.
- Page: https://taohq.org/products/bottles
- App: https://bottles.taohq.org

### Sober.Spend
UPI budgeting, before you pay ("Spend like you're sober."). Scan a UPI QR in the app to see what the payment does to your month and category, then pay or skip; paying opens your own UPI app with details filled in and logs the expense (the app never moves money). Monthly budget view with a daily allowance and a pixel-cat status from CHILL to BROKE, spend lists, subscription tracking, auto-categories, and bill splitting where only your share counts. No bank linking, no SMS reading, works offline. For people in India who pay with UPI. Early access via waitlist.
- Page: https://taohq.org/products/sober-spend
- Waitlist: https://sober.spend.taohq.org

### Bubbles.space
A personal AI workspace OS where Bubbles, your AI assistant, lives and works alongside you. Part of the Bubbles family of AI-agent-first apps. In development.
- Page: https://taohq.org/products/bubbles-space

### Bubbles.mail
An intelligent mail client from the Bubbles family that turns a raw inbox into an information report: what needs attention, what can wait, what to delegate. In development.
- Page: https://taohq.org/products/bubbles-mail

### web-have-sounds (open source)
A zero-dependency JavaScript library that generates UI sound effects (click, pop, toggle, tick, drop, success, error, warning, startup) with the Web Audio API, with no audio files and no network requests. Nine "feels" (soft, aero, arcade, organic, glass, industrial, minimal, retro, crisp).
- Install: npm i @thenormvg/web-have-sounds
- Page: https://taohq.org/products/web-have-sounds
- GitHub: https://github.com/NormVg/web-have-sound
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@thenormvg/web-have-sounds

## Studio

taohq builds for clients: interface and experience design, full-stack web apps and APIs, automation and tooling, trading tools, landing pages, and brand identity. Start a project: taohq.org@gmail.com (subject "New project") or https://taohq.org/studio.

## Team

A small, independent team, small on purpose. Founder: Vishnu, who designs and builds everything at taohq. https://taohq.org/team

## Careers

No open roles right now. People who want to work with taohq someday can send a short note and a link to their work to taohq.org@gmail.com. https://taohq.org/careers

## Design and brand

- Design language: ink (#151515) backgrounds, lavender (#C4B5E3) accent, paper (#ECE8F3) text; VT323, IBM Plex Mono and Instrument Serif Italic; dithered art that develops coarse to fine. https://taohq.org/design
- Brand assets: the taohq mark (a four-point spark) as SVG, colours and usage rules. https://taohq.org/brand
